hypotheses.claim: The CheckoutService.complete method lacks idempotency protection, causing duplicate charges on repeated calls with the same checkout_id.
The test expects exactly one charge after two identical complete() calls, but the current implementation produces two charges due to missing deduplication logic.

reproduction.behavior: Two consecutive calls to CheckoutService.complete with identical checkout_id and amount_cents result in two Charge records instead of one.
reproduction.test_source:
import unittest
from app.checkout import CheckoutGateway, CheckoutService

class TestCheckoutIdempotency(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_complete_charges_once_on_retry(self):
        gateway = CheckoutGateway()
        service = CheckoutService(gateway)
        service.complete('id_123', 500)
        service.complete('id_123', 500)
        self.assertEqual(len(gateway.charges), 1, msg='RF_DUPLICATE_TRANSACTION')
